items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1976-02-19
items.q: whose name was Park Breck, got the idea that it would be a good thing to have a New Orleans jazz concert. And he knew somebody who knew me. So they came to me and asked me

ctx.x: But even among these people, there was a consciousness of the personalities and the people that had recorded the early jazz. Some of those people, of course, were playing in swing bands. And the fact that I had this collection became very well known in school, and people used to come to my room all the time to listen to records. And to discuss with me the music that they were playing, and they were much interested in this. Well, in 1935, the American Newspaper Guild was about to, was planning an annual affair.…
Now, had you done any of this kind of thing before?
